_note: b-roll library for Revision 2 (builder: research workflow). Windows are seconds in the time base of `path` (masters keep their own time base; the clips/broll files start at 0). Paths under the project are project-relative; deck assets are absolute. subject_xy is where the subject sits in the 16:9 frame (0-1) for circle/square masks; a window may carry its own subject_xy that overrides the item value. `audio` says whether the file has an audio track (new clips/broll files are silent). Items marked ai-video are AI-generated and must be captioned as such. Strips (6 frames over the windows, labelled with source timestamps) are in research/rev2/broll/strips/<id>.jpg.
